title: Isaiah Likely already sees why Malik Nabers is Giants’ ‘alpha receiver’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Isaiah Likely already sees why Malik Nabers is Giants’ ‘alpha receiver’
sources.description: Tight end Isaiah Likely has never played a game with Malik Nabers as a teammate, but the newcomer to the Giants says he understands what Nabers can do to elevate an offense.
